recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-32907 target reference set while preserving later Organization support from FHIR-45470 and already-applied Patient/RelatedPerson support for self collection.
issue_request: FHIR-32907 was a Published OO change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for patient-collected specimens. The accepted resolution said Specimen.collection.collector should use the same pattern as Observation.performer: Reference(Practitioner | PractitionerRole | Organization | CareTeam | Patient | RelatedPerson).
initial_application: The Jira comment linked PR 1413 commit 037b22d as merged into the build; that GitHub commit was a merge into the FHIR-32907 branch, and local source history shows 06221389b5 added Patient to Specimen.collection.collector. FHIR-26922 later added RelatedPerson in f2178d9b22, and FHIR-45470 later added Organization in 7326eeac41. Before reconciliation, the current source had Organization, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, and RelatedPerson, but no CareTeam targetProfile.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes specimen=Specimen, making the Specimen StructureDefinition a current-build source. Current Observation.performer includes CareTeam among its allowed reference targets, matching the pattern named in the FHIR-32907 resolution. OO Confluence minutes record FHIR-32907 in the September 2021 Specimen block vote and accepted on the main OO call. Corrected Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-32907 discussion or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Added http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CareTeam to the authoritative Specimen.collection.collector targetProfile list and updated the checked-in source/specimen/specimen.svg type display alongside that source change. Search parameters and unrelated performer elements were left unchanged because they do not carry the collector targetProfile list.
source_changes: source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: added the CareTeam targetProfile to Specimen.collection.collector.
source/specimen/specimen.svg: updated the checked-in Specimen collector type display to include CareTeam.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published Specimen self-collection issue requested Patient and RelatedPerson on the same collector element and explains why those targets were already present.
Later Applied issue added direct Organization support and was already represented on the combined branch; it did not narrow or remove the CareTeam target accepted in FHIR-32907.
